description: Insert the automatic page number placeholder (Seitenzahl-Platzhalter) into text frame frame_id at position "start" or "end" (default end). Works on master page frames too. Returns frame_id and position.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

name: insert_page_number_marker
title: Insert page number marker
